'''Birsingrial''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known for its jewel-caves. [[Besany Wennen]]'s family once went there on a vacation when she was about ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="Order 66" />
